verdict.rationale: Solo 2 runs entirely on hardware you own: passkeys stay on the key, "not their cloud," and it needs no software or drivers. Its open firmware can be built and flashed yourself on the Hacker variant, and you can program your own attestation key, so the core product is fully under user control with no vendor-hosted dependency. Missing for 10: own-firmware builds are limited to the Hacker variant, not the standard key; there is no independent hands-on report of a self-built deployment; and maintenance is stale, with no firmware release since 2022 and a broken official CLI.
